name: gifq-catalog
description: Browse the GIFQ gift card catalog: brands, countries, currencies, face values and how to redeem.

interface.longDescription:
Search every gift card brand GIFQ lists and see where each one works. Filter by country, category or currency, then open a brand for its face values, expiry, redemption steps and terms.

It's useful when you're planning rewards, incentives or payouts for people in different countries and want to know which brands they can actually use.

The app only shows catalog information. It doesn't sell gift cards, show prices or ask for any personal details.
capabilities: Search gift card brands by name
Filter brands by country, category or currency
Show face values, expiry, redemption steps and terms for a brand
Summarize the catalog by category, country and currency
defaultPrompt: Which gift cards can I send to employees in Brazil?
Is Zalando available in Denmark, and in what amounts?
Show me gaming gift cards in GBP.

positive.description: Find brands that work in one country
positive.prompt: Which gift cards can I send to employees in Brazil?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_brands with country Brazil and shows the brand grid. The catalog has about 73 brands for Brazil, such as Airbnb Brazil and Americanas.com Brazil, all in BRL.

positive.description: Check one brand in one market, including amounts
positive.prompt: Is Zalando available in Denmark, and in what amounts?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Zalando Denmark (zalando-dk) and opens it with get_brand. Answers yes, in DKK, for any amount from DKK 40 to DKK 1,500, with a 5-year expiry.

positive.description: Filter by category and currency together
positive.prompt: Show me gaming gift cards in GBP.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_brands with category Gaming and currency GBP and shows about 15 UK brands, such as Blizzard United Kingdom and Epic Fortnite Wallet United Kingdom.

positive.description: Explain how to redeem a specific card
positive.prompt: How does someone redeem an Amazon Germany gift card?
positive.expected_behavior: Opens Amazon Germany (amazon-de) and points to Amazon's redemption help page from the brand record. Also mentions it works in AT, DE, LU and PL, in EUR, and expires ten years after issue.

positive.prompt: How many gift card brands does GIFQ list, and which categories are the biggest?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_catalog_overview and reports about 5,400 brands, with Fashion & Accessories, Travel, Leisure & Auto, and Food & Drink as the largest categories.

negative.description: Buying a gift card. The app only browses the catalog and has no purchase flow, so it should say it can't buy cards and offer to show the brand's details instead.
negative.prompt: Buy me a €50 Zalando gift card for Germany.

negative.description: Asking for prices or discounts. The catalog carries no pricing, so the app should say it doesn't have prices rather than guess.
negative.prompt: What's the cheapest price for a $100 Steam card right now?

negative.description: Checking a card balance. The app has no access to card codes or balances, so it should not call any tool with the code and should suggest checking with the brand.
negative.prompt: Check the balance on my Amazon gift card, code AQ7X-29KD-LM3P.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search and browse the GIFQ gift card catalog by country, category and currency, and open any brand for its face values, expiry, redemption steps and terms.
